---
title: "Loading, integrating and exploring data"
---

This repository is the teaching material for **Sections 2.b, 2.c, 2.d and 2.e**.

The HarborLink documents (2.b–2.d) use one fictitious subscription company. Those datasets are entirely synthetic. Section 2.e then uses a customer-level telco table plus generated communications to train a predictive model.

## Section 2.b — From business information to analysis-ready data

How can we transform information produced in everyday business activities into structured data that Python can load?

Main document: `lessons/02b-data-loading.qmd`

## Section 2.c — One analysis table from several sources

Join the HarborLink extracts into one invoice-level DataFrame (`lessons/02c-exploratory-analysis.qmd`).

## Section 2.d — Exploratory analysis and data visualisation

Explore and visualise that table with pandas, matplotlib and seaborn (`lessons/02d-eda-visualisation.qmd`).

## Section 2.e — From structured data to a predictive model

Once a table is ready, how do we turn numbers **and** text into a probability of churn?

Main document: `lessons/02e-churn-text-ml.qmd`

Practice notebook: `notebooks/02e-churn-text-ml.ipynb`

The session formalizes early fusion (tabular fields + TF–IDF / SVD text), logistic regression, evaluation metrics, and explanations (permutation importance, LIME).

## How to follow the lessons

Open the Quarto file for the session and execute the Python cells in order. The HarborLink demonstrations do not require an ERP, a CRM, API keys or an internet connection. The modelling session reads local CSV files already present in `data/raw/telco/`.
